classification: DMG-specific documented frame timing plus captured LCD-interface latch behavior

sources.title: Nintendo Game Boy Programming Manual
facts: LY spans 0-153 and LY 144-153 is vertical blanking

sources.title: Capturing the Gameboy LCD with an FPGA
facts: S/VSYNC rising starts a frame and stays high for the first line
LD0 and LD1 shift on CP/CLK rising edges
CPL rising latches the complete 160-pixel line and marks line end
blanking contains CPL pulses without CP/CLK pixel shifts

runtimeModel.timebase: The 59.7275 Hz physical-surrogate frame period divided by 154 lines; the manual and capture values are retained as independent rounded/measured cross-checks.
runtimeModel.normalLatchBasis: Captured CPL rising edge latches the line at line end.
runtimeModel.opticalDeadTimeBasis: No separate pure optical dead time is established; director motion begins causally with the changed electrical drive.
runtimeModel.sourceHistory: OriginalHistory1 supplies the previous rendered core frame; Source supplies the current rendered core frame.
runtimeModel.unsupportedSubframes: When TotalSubFrames is not one, initialize a static current-target state instead of advancing physical history multiple times.

uncertainties: Sub-line analogue row/column voltage settling after CPL
Exact DMG-LCD-01 equivalence to the captured console and DMG-LCD-06 topology
Frontend behavior under rewind, run-ahead, dropped emulated frames, and non-monotonic time
